text:
alex_dev Hey — thinking about quickfilter/save-query UX for cross-route / cross-model views. Current ask: allow engineers to compose a single view that shows per-route AND per-model breakdowns side-by-side, and persist it as a saved query. How do we handle quotas + telemetry attribution when one saved view hits multiple routes/models?

maria_pm Good q. Two concerns: (1) cost preview for the whole saved view (sum of routes/models) and (2) ownership/visibility when a saved query spans other teams' routes.

jenna_product We also need to consider rollouts: users expect a "pin model variant" toggle so a saved view can be locked to a model version during canary. If they don't pin, query semantics should fallback to current default model for each route.

devon_sre From infra side: cross-model views can trigger parallel requests across backends. We should show an estimated token throughput + worst-case latency in the preview. Also quota enforcement is per-route token limit today; combining routes should surface per-route impacts not just a global sum.

alex_dev Proposal sketch: saved_query schema adds two fields: scope: ["route:...","model:..."] and cost_preview: {"estimated_tokens": "N", "per_route_estimate": ["r1: N1","r2: N2"]}. UI shows both total and per-route estimates. Example:```json
{
  "name": "Support dashboard + embeddings",
  "scope": ["route:/support","model:gpt-open-1.ql"],
  "pin_model": true
}
```

maria_pm Ownership: suggest a save-metadata flag owner_team and a visibility enum {personal, team, org}. If view touches other teams' routes, default to personal + warning modal. Also show a "request share" button to ask route owner for team visibility.

devon_sre :eyes: For telemetry, we need attribution mapping so when a saved view is queried we tag each request with saved_query_id + route_id + model_version. That way sampling and evals can be grouped. ops-analytics should be able to filter by saved_query_id.

ops-analytics Agree — ops/analytics: please add saved_query_id to telemetry envelope. One caveat: saved views that include wildcard scopes (e.g., route:*/infra) could generate a lot of metrics. Default sample_rate for saved-query telemetry should be adjustable per-query.

jenna_product UX notes: 1) Add a compact "toggle per-model breakdown" pill in the header so users can collapse/expand model columns. 2) In the save flow show a cost toggle: "Show cost preview before saving". 3) If saving cross-team, show a confirm that lists affected routes.

alex_dev Internal API implications: saved-queries endpoint currently returns {id, name, filter}. We need to extend to include scope[], pin_model(bool), owner_team, visibility, telemetry_sample_rate, and cost_preview_snapshot_id. Backwards-compatible if we default new fields.

devon_sre Implementation note: when executing a saved view, route router should fan-out requests with a header `X-Saved-Query-ID: <id>` and `X-Saved-Query-Scope: route=/...,model=...`. That header will help trace in logs without changing payload.

maria_pm Rollouts UX: if saved view pins a model that later gets deprecated, how do we surface that? Suggest the console marks the saved-query with an amber badge "pinned model deprecated" and on open shows a banner with suggested replacements. Also allow bulk migrate saved queries to a replacement model.

jenna_product Edge case: what about saved queries that rely on ephemeral route aliases used only during testing? We should allow a "bind-on-save" option to resolve aliases to concrete route IDs, otherwise warn about brittle references.

ops-analytics Quick ask: can we add a lightweight telemetry preview in the save modal that shows last 7-day token count for the scope? Even rough numbers help teams decide whether to pin/optimize.

alex_dev I'll draft a small API PR and a console mockup. Plan: (1) extend saved_queries API, (2) add header tagging for runtime, (3) add telemetry_sample_rate control, (4) preview panel in UI. I'll ping frontend + SRE for perf constraints.

maria_pm sgtm. Jenna, can your team prototype the modal copy & warnings? Devon, ops-analytics will need a short migration task to index saved_query_id.

jenna_product Yep, we'll sketch flows. Will include the confirm flow for cross-team saves and the "request share" button.

devon_sre I'll add header parsing and a small rate-limiter tweak so combined saved-views hit route quotas gracefully. Also will add a fallback path: if a pinned model is unavailable, fallback to route's default and surface a specific error code.

console-bot deploy-bot: New PR opened by alex_dev #2314 — saved-query schema + telemetry headers. CI queued.

alex_dev Thanks everyone. Filing the design doc now: https://redwood.example.com/d/rlx-console-saved-query-crossscope — ping me if you want early access to the mockups. :thumbsup:
